snippet.title: Ramen Shop Simulator - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique restaurant. The aroma of success is just a bowl away!

This demo is an early taste of whats to come. We are working hard building the best ramen business game and want to give you a preview.

Try the demo today on Steam and wishlist!
